name: io.github.chrischall/warapp-mcp
description: war.app (Warzone) game advisor — games, maps, bonuses, routes, live board, picks, turns and chat

environmentVariables.name: WARAPP_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: The email address you sign in to war.app with.

environmentVariables.name: WARAPP_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your war.app API token, from https://war.app/API/GetAPIToken while signed in.

environmentVariables.name: WARAPP_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: fetchproxy bridge concentrator port for the live-game tools. Defaults to the fleet-shared 37149.

environmentVariables.name: WARAPP_ENV_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional dotenv file with WARAPP_EMAIL / WARAPP_API_TOKEN (default ~/.config/warapp-mcp/.env)
